text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Benign Paroxysmal Positional Vertigo (BPPV). The combination of sudden onset, positional triggers (suggested by your head movement questions), and the positive likelihood of the Dix-Hallpike maneuver points to displaced otoconia in the semicircular canals. I recommend the Epley maneuver for treatment.
